courses.title: Algebra and Calculus Methods
courses.note: Incompatible with MATH1013, MATH1113, and MATH1115.

courses.title: Mathematics and Applications 1
courses.note: Incompatible with MATH1113 and MATH1115, including concurrent enrolment.

courses.title: Advanced Mathematics and Applications 1
courses.note: If you have previously completed MATH1013 or MATH1113, you may only enrol with permission of the course convener.

courses.title: Introduction to Mathematical Thinking: Problem-Solving and Proofs
courses.note: Requires MATH1116 (mark of at least 50), MATH1113 (at least 60), MATH1005 (at least 70), or MATH1013/MATH1014 (at least 80); exceptional students may take it alongside MATH1115. Incompatible with MATH2322, MATH3104, MATH2320, MATH3116, and MATH6222.

courses.title: Applied Mathematics I
courses.note: Alternatively: MATH1113 with a mark of at least 80, or MATH1013 with a mark over 80, each with concurrent enrolment in MATH1014. Incompatible with MATH6405.

courses.title: Bioinformatics and Biological Modelling
courses.note: Requires 12 units of 1000-level MATH courses. Incompatible with MATH6100.

courses.title: Advanced Analysis 1: Metric Spaces and Applications
courses.note: Requires a mark of 60 or above in MATH1116. Incompatible with MATH3116.

courses.title: Fractal Geometry and Chaotic Dynamics
courses.note: Requires any 2000- or 3000-level MATH course with a mark of 60 or above, or MATH1116 with a mark of 80 or above. Incompatible with MATH6116.

courses.title: Advanced Complex Analysis
courses.note: Requires a mark of 60 or above in MATH2320.

courses.title: Number Theory and Cryptography
courses.note: Requires MATH1014 (mark of at least 80) or MATH1116 (at least 60), each with 72 units of tertiary study including 24 units of MATH courses; alternatively, at least one 2000- or 3000-level MATH course. Incompatible with MATH6114.

courses.title: Topics in Computational Maths Honours
courses.note: Requires enrolment in the MATH-HSPC Honours specialisation. Incompatible with MATH6201 and MATH8201.
